Breadcrumbing
BRED-krumb-ing
verb / noun (modern dating slang)
Coined within the online-dating discourse of the mid-2010s; describes the manipulative pattern of giving a romantic interest just enough attention (a like, a text, an occasional date) to keep them invested without committing to anything substantive. The user is fed breadcrumbs rather than a meal — just enough to keep them coming back, never enough to satisfy.

Biblical Definition

Modern dating slang for the manipulative pattern of giving a romantic interest just enough attention (a like, a text, an occasional date) to keep them invested without committing to anything substantive. The user is fed breadcrumbs rather than a meal — just enough to keep them coming back, never enough to satisfy. From a biblical-ethical standpoint, breadcrumbing is the sin of false signaling: a sustained low-cost pretense of interest that exploits the other person's hopeful expectation while preserving the breadcrumb-giver's options. Scripture's command on this kind of speech and conduct is clear: let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay (Matthew 5:37); lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight (Proverbs 12:22); let love be without dissimulation (Romans 12:9, let love be without hypocrisy); laying aside therefore all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies (1 Peter 2:1). Breadcrumbing is structurally dishonest courtship: signaling interest without intending substantive commitment, exploiting the other party's investment, refusing both the honesty of pursuit and the honesty of decline. The patriarchal-Reformed recovery of biblical courtship under parental authority — deliberate intentional pursuit toward marriage, or honest decline — rules out breadcrumbing structurally. There is no place in covenantal courtship for stringing-along.

Webster 1828 Definition

Modern dating slang for the manipulative pattern of giving just enough attention to keep someone invested without substantive commitment; structurally dishonest courtship; ruled out by biblical commands on honest speech and intentional pursuit.

BREADCRUMBING, v. / n. (modern dating slang; coined mid-2010s online-dating discourse) The manipulative pattern of giving a romantic interest just enough attention (a like, a text, an occasional date) to keep them invested without committing to anything substantive. The user is fed breadcrumbs rather than a meal. Structurally dishonest courtship: signaling interest without intending substantive commitment; exploiting the other party's investment; refusing both the honesty of pursuit and the honesty of decline. Ruled out by biblical commands on honest speech (Matthew 5:37; Proverbs 12:22; Romans 12:9; 1 Peter 2:1) and the patriarchal-Reformed recovery of biblical courtship under parental authority.

Key Scripture

Matthew 5:37 — "But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil."

Proverbs 12:22 — "Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight."

Romans 12:9 — "Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good."

1 Peter 2:1 — "Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings."

Modern Corruption

Breadcrumbing is structurally dishonest courtship: low-cost pretense of interest exploiting the other party's hopeful expectation; ruled out by biblical honesty.

expand to see more

The substantive corruption of breadcrumbing is structural dishonesty. The breadcrumb-giver invests just enough attention to keep the other party hopeful, never enough to commit; he benefits from the other party's continued investment (emotional reassurance, optionality, social-media engagement, sexual access in some cases) while bearing none of the costs of either honest pursuit or honest decline. The exploited party invests heart, hope, and life-direction in someone who has carefully arranged not to invest reciprocally. The pattern is by design dishonest: it requires the breadcrumb-giver to communicate enough interest to sustain the other's hope while staying carefully short of anything that would constitute genuine commitment.

The patriarchal-Reformed recovery of biblical courtship rules out breadcrumbing structurally. Courtship under parental authority is deliberate, intentional, and aimed at marriage; the man approaches the woman's father, declares his intention, and proceeds toward marriage with the woman's family's involvement. There is no place in this framework for the casual stringing-along of a romantic interest with breadcrumbs; either he intends to pursue her toward marriage (and so does, openly and accountably) or he does not (and so declines, honestly and clearly). The slang itself names the corruption; the biblical alternative is to refuse the corruption.

Hebrew Roots

Mid-2010s online-dating slang; the manipulative low-cost pretense of romantic interest.
